title: footprint.comment 1.0.0
description: What `footprint comment` did with the pull request's one Footprint comment: which comment it wrote, whether it created, updated or adopted it, and the Changelog row it appended. The comment's body is not repeated here; the comment itself is the record.

action.description: created: no Footprint comment existed and one was posted. updated: an existing one was edited in place. Under --dry-run, what would have been done.

adopted.description: True when the comment updated carried no marker: the most recent comment by the current gh user that opened with '## Footprint', which now carries the marker

id.description: The comment's id; null only for a dry run that would have created one

url.description: The comment's html_url as GitHub answered the write; null under --dry-run

head_sha.description: The first 7 characters of the pull request's head commit when the command ran, as gh pr view reported it

row.description: The Changelog row appended, before cell escaping

remarks.description: As given, followed by a statement of adoption when the comment was adopted

rows.description: Rows the comment carries now, the new one included

carried.description: Rows the comment carried before this run

dropped.description: Older rows dropped to stay within the limit, this run's and every earlier run's, as the comment states

chars.description: The length of the comment body written, in characters

limit.description: GitHub's maximum comment body; chars is at most this
